importYaml.description: Paste your Home Assistant automation YAML below. The automation can be in standard format or state machine format.

alias: My Automation

connect.title: Connect to Home Assistant
connect.subtitle: Flow needs a URL and a long-lived access token to run standalone.
connect.tokenHelp: Create one in HA: Profile → Security → Long-Lived Access Tokens

errors.missingFields: Please provide both a URL and a token.

errors.corsHint:
Could not reach the server. If Home Assistant is up, this is likely CORS — add to configuration.yaml:
http:
  cors_allowed_origins:
    - {{origin}}
